queries: WITH counts AS (SELECT o.timespan, COUNT(*) AS risk_margin_count FROM riskandmargin AS r JOIN orders AS o ON r.ordervault = o.recordvault WHERE o.timespan IS NOT NULL GROUP BY o.timespan), shares AS (SELECT timespan, risk_margin_count, risk_margin_count::numeric / SUM(risk_margin_count) OVER () AS share FROM counts) SELECT timespan, risk_margin_count, share, ABS(share - AVG(share) OVER ()) AS distance_from_average_share FROM shares ORDER BY timespan;
